name: la3a-bus-level
description: Firmer, more aggressive LA-3A opto leveling in LIMIT mode for a drum/instrument bus that wants to sit tight and forward. Limit mode, Peak Reduction 6, hf_emphasis 20 (a little low-end off the detector), Gain 5. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus: LUFS -17.18->-16.08 (+1.10 denser), crest 17.17->16.26, true-peak -0.98, LRA 2.44->1.72 (notably tighter — firm leveling), low-mid ratio 0.179->0.198 + centroid 1747->1762 (more body/presence). The in-your-face counterpart to la3a-drum-glue; use Limit + more PR when you want it to grab harder.
intended_for: a drum / instrument bus that wants firmer, more aggressive opto leveling (LIMIT mode) — tighter and more in-your-face than la3a-drum-glue
plugin_build: uaudio_la3a.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless & processes offline; the /Components/UAD Teletronix LA-3A.component twin PASSES THROUGH offline, do not use it).
notes: LIMIT mode = higher effective ratio / harder knee than Comp at the same PR (lower crest, slightly darker).
hf_emphasis 20 keeps a little low-end out of the detector so it doesn't pump on the kick, but still levels firmly.
comp_limit + meter are string enums -> preset harness only.
Re-dial Peak Reduction to the GR you hear; this is firmer leveling, not a smash — for parallel crush use la3a-parallel-smash.
